what.text: This page follows refugees from El Salvador living in Canada, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 760 Salvadoran refugees in Canada, 1.1% of all refugees from El Salvador.
The United States hosts the most Salvadoran refugees, followed by Mexico, Italy and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of El Salvador with the FMLN from 1989 to 1991.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1994 and 1995, come just after that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at its highest figure, 11082 refugees.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
These are year-end totals for Canada only, reported to UNHCR.
